reviews.comment: Don't underestimate this course. It is definitely doable to get an A, but you do have to study. Make sure you do the quizzes at the end of the reading, since the exams are very similar questions.
The course is not very difficult if you like politics. It is very lecture heavy. Lectures are fairly boring.

Dr. Rotem is a really chill guy, he and this course came off as a bit intimidating but in the end he proved to be a chill grader who just wanted to see his students learn the material and prove it on exams and homework, just read the chapter's, and if you are struggling to retain info try the InQuizitive questions and you'll be fine!
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--EXTRA CREDIT--Online Savvy

reviews.comment: Dr. Dvir is a supportive professor. 4 exams, lowest one is dropped. He offers extra credit at the end. Get 60% attendance points for full credit. He explains material well and is very available to help. The material is really dense and complex, so read the textbook. Many inquizitive questions are on the exams. Just do a lot of reading for an A.

Very nice professor. Drops the lowest test as well as offering an extra credit assignment. The lectures are pretty important but it can be hard to hear him at times as he doesn't use a microphone so sit at the front. He provided numerous ways to study including a way built in to the textbook website called inquisitive as well as an ai tool.

i coasted through the semester and crammed the night before every exam and ended the class with a B. if you study hard and put in the work, you'll get an A. he's a very nice professor, he dropped the lowest exam grade and curved the exams as well.
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: He was a boring professor, but he provided the necessary materials to help you succeed. Inquiztive was my best friend in this class so use that and the resource questions. I studied hard and the best I could get on an exam was an 87, so take that as you will lol. There are HW quizzes for each chapter of the textbook and 4 exams.
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Very middle of the road POLS class, prepare to work a lot for an A, or coast through the semester and get a B.

POLS 231 (It won't let me pick). This class in not an easy A at all. You definitely have to work for it and by that I mean read the textbook. Professor Dvir is helpful through email and will meet with you in person if you ask. He dropped our lowest exam and offered an extra credit opportunity. While it was hard, he was helpful through the process.
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--Lots of homework--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Dvir is a super intuitive professor and his lectures, while they feel long, and generally pretty interesting. He always goes into great detail, and makes sure everything is clear. There are 2 big papers, a few super easy surveys that are for participation, and attendance grades. Great professor and would highly recommend.
reviews.ratingTags: Graded by few things--Lecture heavy--Tough grader

reviews.comment: Professor Dvir is a great professor! He is very funny and makes himself very available for students if they need help. I would definitely recommend taking him if you like writing. His class is based on two large papers, but he makes himself very available to help weeks in advance so it's not bad! I would definitely take him again.
reviews.ratingTags: Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class--Graded by few things
